en.headline: Customs seize 19kg cannabis buds at airport in two cases
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs said officers seized about 19 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated value of HK$4 million and arrested four mainland men at the airport.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected two drug trafficking cases involving incoming air passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Monday and Tuesday, seizing a total of about 19 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about HK$4 million, and arrested four mainland Chinese men.

In the first case, officers found about 11 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds concealed in snack packaging inside the carry-on baggage of a 59-year-old man who arrived from Guangzhou on Monday. A 40-year-old man who arrived from Bangkok on Tuesday and was suspected to be connected was also arrested, and nine sticks of duty-not-paid cigarettes were found on him.

In the second case, two men aged 26 and 49 who arrived from Bangkok on Tuesday had about 8 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds in the carry-on baggage of one of them. Both were arrested. Investigations continue.

Customs said trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance. The department urged the public not to carry unknown items for others.

zh.headline: 海關機場破兩宗販毒案 檢約19公斤大麻花拘4名內地男子
zh.dek: 海關表示在香港國際機場兩宗案件中檢獲約19公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約400萬元，並拘捕四名內地男子。
body: 香港海關在星期一及星期二於香港國際機場偵破兩宗涉及入境航空旅客的販運危險藥物案件，共檢獲約19公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約400萬港元，並拘捕四名內地男子。
首宗案件中，海關人員在一名星期一從廣州抵港的59歲男子的手提行李內，發現約11公斤以零食包裝掩飾的懷疑大麻花，隨即拘捕他。經調查後，再拘捕一名星期二從曼谷抵港、懷疑與案有關的40歲男子，並在其身上檢獲9支未完稅香煙。
第二宗案件中，兩名分别26歲及49歲、星期二從曼谷抵港的男子，其中一人的手提行李內藏有約8公斤懷疑大麻花，兩人均被拘捕。案件仍在調查。
海關表示，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。部門呼籲市民切勿為他人攔帶不明物品。
